response.sql:
WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    AVG(t.amount) as account_avg_amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(account_avg_amount) as region_avg_amount
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY region
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as overall_avg
  FROM region_avgs
)
SELECT 
  r.region,
  r.region_avg_amount,
  r.region_avg_amount - o.overall_avg as exceeds_by,
  r.region_avg_amount / o.overall_avg as ratio
FROM region_avgs r
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE r.region_avg_amount > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: trans.amount is averaged as unsigned stored values, without applying transaction direction from trans.type (PRIJEM = credit, VYDAJ = withdrawal, VYBER undocumented). This treats amounts as transaction magnitudes rather than net signed flows.

alternatives.interpretation: If transaction direction should be incorporated: convert amounts to signed values (PRIJEM = +amount, VYDAJ = −amount), handling undocumented VYBER as NULL. This produces net transaction flows per account rather than transaction magnitude averages.

WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
              WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
              ELSE NULL END) as account_avg_amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(account_avg_amount) as region_avg_amount
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY region
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as overall_avg
  FROM region_avgs
)
SELECT 
  r.region,
  r.region_avg_amount,
  r.region_avg_amount - o.overall_avg as exceeds_by,
  r.region_avg_amount / o.overall_avg as ratio
FROM region_avgs r
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE r.region_avg_amount > o.overall_avg
